svg.text: header order on the board: GND + SW DT CLK
header order on the board: GND + SW DT CLK
Toggles: one lug → GPIO, other lug → GND. No resistor (INPUT_PULLUP).
D13 → [150 Ω] → long leg (+) short leg (−) → GND
C1 100–470 µF + to 3V3, stripe (−) to GND. Mount close to the ESP32's 3V3/GND pins.
All three displays share 3V3, GND, SCL, SDA, DC and RST.
Only CS is separate — that is how the code picks a screen.
Optional: 100 nF ceramic across VCC/GND at each display.
⚠ Replace the in-plane right-angle header with a straight
header on the back, or solder wires — see CASE_NOTES.
0.3 m cable inside the case → ESP32 USB-C port. Powers everything.
• KY-040 '+' goes to 3V3, never 5 V. Its board has pull-ups on CLK/DT; SW uses INPUT_PULLUP.
• GPIO 34/35/36/39 are input-only (fine for LDR and encoder CLK/DT). D15 is a strapping pin — harmless for a toggle.
• ↑ / ↓ = wire routed over / under the board from a right-side pin. Every safe GPIO is now used. Match wires by the printed label.
ISS MONITOR — wiring (triangle console: 3 screens, 6 toggles, 2 encoders, LED, LDR)
junction dots = connected; crossings without a dot are not
